gaps.lead: Phoebe was surprised to be offered a place on the course.
gaps.sentence: The offer of a place on the course ___ Phoebe.
gaps.hint: surprised by = come as a surprise to
gaps.explanation: 'Was surprised' becomes 'came as a surprise to her'.

gaps.lead: A professional will repair the roof next week.
gaps.explanation: 'Have something done' — arranged service: have the roof repaired.

gaps.lead: He had just got home when the power cut happened.
gaps.sentence: ___ home when the power cut happened.

gaps.lead: They cancelled the match because of the rain.
gaps.sentence: The match ___ because of the rain.

gaps.lead: She found it hard to understand the accent.
gaps.explanation: 'Have difficulty (in) doing' = find it hard to do.

gaps.lead: 'Why don't we hold the wedding outdoors?' said Ana.
gaps.explanation: suggest + that-clause, or suggest + -ing: suggested they hold / suggested holding.
